IMPORTANCE NOTICE TO ALL STUDENTS BEFORE SITTING FOR THE FINAL EXAMINATION
1. Students are allowed to bring required stationeries only into the examination hall, without the container.
2. Calculators are allowed to be brought in, but with no casings.
3. Students who bring along their mobile phones must ensure they are switched off and be placed on the floor at the left side of the desk.
The use of mobile phones during the examination is strictly prohibited.
